zombietide.ambush.1: They are here. From every side.
zombietide.ambush.10: The first one hauled itself over the sill, then the second, then the third.
zombietide.ambush.11: The door gave way, and they flooded in like a tide.
zombietide.ambush.12: No pause. Only more and more footsteps.
zombietide.ambush.2: The door took its first dull thud, then a second, then a third.
zombietide.ambush.3: In the dark, countless eyes lit up at once.
zombietide.ambush.4: You had not even shut the door before the steps crowded the wall outside.
zombietide.ambush.5: The ground trembled under the stamp of a hundred feet.
zombietide.ambush.6: Glass shattered, and a cold wind poured in with the stench of rot.
zombietide.ambush.7: They did not roar or cry. They only kept coming.
zombietide.ambush.8: A gust beat out the torch, and the dark closed in at once.
zombietide.ambush.9: With your back to the wall, you heard scratching on every side.
zombietide.morning.1: Morning came. But something about today feels wrong.
zombietide.morning.10: The air pressed down, heavy, as if something bore it down.
zombietide.morning.11: Today is no day to go far.
zombietide.morning.12: You went through your pack and checked everything you could use.
zombietide.morning.13: Your heart beat faster than it should, and would not settle.
zombietide.morning.14: Somewhere far off, something was moving, slowly.
zombietide.morning.15: The wind went around this place. Not a sound was left.
zombietide.morning.16: You held what was in your hands a little tighter.
zombietide.morning.17: You could not bring yourself to smile.
zombietide.morning.18: One more shadow. You counted twice to be sure.
zombietide.morning.19: The sky turned light, but something had not lifted.
zombietide.morning.2: A new day began as always. You felt no relief.
zombietide.morning.20: Your hand never left your weapon all day.
zombietide.morning.21: Far away, dust kept drifting into the air.
zombietide.morning.22: Even the insects hid themselves away today.
zombietide.morning.23: You made your preparations early, though you had no need of them yet.
zombietide.morning.24: Something burned, and only then did you come back to yourself.
zombietide.morning.25: The light was wrong. Red, and wrong.
zombietide.morning.26: You heard a dull rumble far off, like many footsteps.
zombietide.morning.27: No one should be alone today.
zombietide.morning.28: Everything you could carry, you carried.
zombietide.morning.29: Something seemed to stand at the edge of your sight. You turned. Nothing.
zombietide.morning.3: The wind carried a scent of rust and earth.
zombietide.morning.30: The light flickered, though there was no wind here.
zombietide.morning.31: Today even time seemed to move slower.
zombietide.morning.32: You glanced behind you. There was nothing there.
zombietide.morning.33: The stores were enough, yet you had no appetite at all.
zombietide.morning.34: Something circled far off for a long while before it scattered.
zombietide.morning.35: You pressed a hand to your chest to confirm you were still alive.
zombietide.morning.36: This stillness was the kind that comes before the storm.
zombietide.morning.37: You finished every preparation you could think of, early.
zombietide.morning.38: Before the dark comes, you must have everything ready.
zombietide.morning.39: You sharpened your weapon earlier than ever, and more carefully.
zombietide.morning.4: The sounds around you grew sharp, then stopped all at once.
zombietide.morning.40: Tonight they will come. You have known it all along.
zombietide.morning.5: It was too quiet today. There was not even an echo.
zombietide.morning.6: You checked your gear once. Then checked it again.
zombietide.morning.7: Nothing stirred in the distance. The quiet was wrong.
zombietide.morning.8: You checked the things that needed checking. Three times.
zombietide.morning.9: You counted your own breaths and waited for time to pass.
zombietide.settings.atmo.item1.desc: Fog colour and view distance on horde day and during waves
zombietide.settings.atmo.item1.name: Enable Atmosphere
zombietide.settings.atmo.item1.tip: Master switch. Turning it off disables fog and camera effects.
zombietide.settings.atmo.item2.desc: Colder light on horde day; view distance squeezed to 96 blocks during waves
zombietide.settings.atmo.item2.name: Fog & View Distance
zombietide.settings.atmo.item2.tip: During a wave you will struggle to see far. That is intentional. Disable if it feels stifling.
zombietide.settings.atmo.item4.desc: Camera dips slightly and returns when a horde triggers
zombietide.settings.atmo.item4.name: Trigger Camera Dip
zombietide.settings.atmo.item4.tip: Very small (about 1.5 degrees). Keep it off if you are prone to motion sickness.
zombietide.settings.common.text18: HUD settings are shared across all worlds
zombietide.settings.hud.item1.desc: Shows the mod day in the top-left
zombietide.settings.hud.item1.name: Enable HUD (DAY X)
zombietide.settings.hud.item1.tip: Off: no DAY X and no villager list.
zombietide.settings.hud.item10.desc: Scale of the villager list text
zombietide.settings.hud.item10.name: Villager HUD Scale
zombietide.settings.hud.item10.tip: Only affects the villager DAY X list, not your own DAY X.
zombietide.settings.hud.item11.name: Display Range (blocks)
zombietide.settings.hud.item11.tip: Villagers beyond this range are not listed.
zombietide.settings.hud.item12.name: Max Entries
zombietide.settings.hud.item12.tip: Taken from the nearest after sorting.
zombietide.settings.hud.item2.desc: Lists nearby villagers below the HUD
zombietide.settings.hud.item2.name: Show Nearby Villagers
zombietide.settings.hud.item2.tip: Sorted by distance, limited to the configured count.
zombietide.settings.hud.item3.name: Bold DAY X
zombietide.settings.hud.item3.tip: Only affects the player's DAY X text.
zombietide.settings.hud.item4.name: Bold Villager List
zombietide.settings.hud.item4.tip: Only affects the villager list text.
zombietide.settings.hud.item5.name: HUD X
zombietide.settings.hud.item6.name: HUD Y
zombietide.settings.hud.item7.name: HUD Scale (x10)
zombietide.settings.hud.item8.desc: Horizontal offset of the villager list
zombietide.settings.hud.item8.name: Villager List X
zombietide.settings.hud.item9.desc: Vertical offset of the villager list
zombietide.settings.hud.item9.name: Villager List Y
zombietide.settings.no_permission: Permission denied: requires OP level 2 (singleplayer: host only)
zombietide.settings.player.item1.desc: Player hordes will not trigger when off
zombietide.settings.player.item1.name: Enable Player Hordes
zombietide.settings.player.item2.desc: Trigger every N days; 1 = every day
zombietide.settings.player.item2.name: Interval (days)
zombietide.settings.player.item2.tip: Player horde period in overworld game days. All players share the same mod day.
zombietide.settings.player.item3.desc: Use a range instead of a fixed interval
zombietide.settings.player.item3.name: Random Interval
zombietide.settings.player.item3.tip: Picks the next interval randomly between the min and max values.
zombietide.settings.player.item4.desc: Lower bound for the random interval
zombietide.settings.player.item4.name: Min Interval
zombietide.settings.player.item4.tip: Only used when Random Interval is on.
zombietide.settings.player.item5.desc: Upper bound for the random interval
zombietide.settings.player.item5.name: Max Interval
zombietide.settings.player.item5.tip: Only used when Random Interval is on.
zombietide.settings.player.item6.name: Horde Size
zombietide.settings.player.item6.tip: Used when Random Count is off. Blood debt is added on top.
zombietide.settings.player.item7.desc: Use a range instead of a fixed count
zombietide.settings.player.item7.name: Random Count
zombietide.settings.player.item7.tip: Picks the horde size randomly between the min and max values.
zombietide.settings.player.item8.desc: Lower bound for the random count
zombietide.settings.player.item8.name: Min Count
zombietide.settings.player.item8.tip: Only used when Random Count is on.
zombietide.settings.player.item9.desc: Upper bound for the random count
zombietide.settings.player.item9.name: Max Count
zombietide.settings.player.item9.tip: Only used when Random Count is on.
zombietide.settings.spawn.item1.name: Batch Interval (ticks)
zombietide.settings.spawn.item1.tip: Lower is faster and more intense; higher is slower.
zombietide.settings.spawn.item10.desc: Weight of darkness in spawn-point scoring
zombietide.settings.spawn.item10.name: Darkness Weight (x100)
zombietide.settings.spawn.item10.tip: Higher favors dark spots. Enter x100, e.g. 60 = 0.6.
zombietide.settings.spawn.item11.desc: Max living horde zombies at once
zombietide.settings.spawn.item11.name: Global Zombie Cap
zombietide.settings.spawn.item11.tip: Spawning pauses at the cap until zombies die.
zombietide.settings.spawn.item2.name: Player Batch Size
zombietide.settings.spawn.item2.tip: One batch per interval, capped by the global zombie limit.
zombietide.settings.spawn.item3.name: Villager Batch Size
zombietide.settings.spawn.item3.tip: One batch per interval, capped by the global zombie limit.
zombietide.settings.spawn.item4.desc: Farthest spawn distance for player hordes
zombietide.settings.spawn.item4.name: Player Spawn Radius
zombietide.settings.spawn.item4.tip: Zombies never spawn farther than this. Actual distance falls between "Min Spawn Distance" and this radius, spread evenly by area. Anything beyond the server simulation distance is clamped, so no new chunks are generated.
zombietide.settings.spawn.item5.desc: Farthest spawn distance for villager hordes
zombietide.settings.spawn.item5.name: Villager Spawn Radius
zombietide.settings.spawn.item5.tip: Zombies never spawn farther than this. Actual distance falls between "Min Spawn Distance" and this radius, spread evenly by area. Anything beyond the server simulation distance is clamped, so no new chunks are generated.
zombietide.settings.spawn.item6.desc: Closest spawn distance (shared by both horde types)
zombietide.settings.spawn.item6.name: Min Spawn Distance
zombietide.settings.spawn.item6.tip: Keeps zombies from spawning on the target. Keep it below the spawn radius, or the two collapse into one ring.
zombietide.settings.spawn.item7.desc: Samples per spawn; higher finds a spot more easily
zombietide.settings.spawn.item7.name: Spawn Attempts
zombietide.settings.spawn.item7.tip: More attempts find valid spots more reliably but cost more.
zombietide.settings.spawn.item8.name: Biome Variants
zombietide.settings.spawn.item8.tip: Off: plain zombies. On: variant picked by the target biome.
zombietide.settings.spawn.item9.desc: Weight of distance in spawn-point scoring
zombietide.settings.spawn.item9.name: Distance Weight (x100)
zombietide.settings.spawn.item9.tip: Higher favors distant spots. Enter x100, e.g. 60 = 0.6.

zombietide.settings.toast.config_saved: §e[Zombie Tide] Config sent to server (no effect without OP)

zombietide.settings.villager.item2.desc: Trigger every N days; 1 = every day
zombietide.settings.villager.item2.name: Interval (days)
zombietide.settings.villager.item2.tip: Villager horde period, synced to overworld game days. All villagers share the same mod day.
zombietide.settings.villager.item3.desc: Use a range instead of a fixed interval

zombietide.settings.villager.item3.tip: Picks the next interval randomly between the min and max values.
zombietide.settings.villager.item4.desc: Lower bound for the random interval
zombietide.settings.villager.item4.name: Min Interval
zombietide.settings.villager.item4.tip: Only used when Random Interval is on.
zombietide.settings.villager.item5.desc: Upper bound for the random interval
zombietide.settings.villager.item5.name: Max Interval
zombietide.settings.villager.item5.tip: Only used when Random Interval is on.
zombietide.settings.villager.item6.name: Horde Size
zombietide.settings.villager.item6.tip: Used when Random Count is off. Villager hordes do not accumulate blood debt.
zombietide.settings.villager.item7.desc: Use a range instead of a fixed count
zombietide.settings.villager.item7.name: Random Count
zombietide.settings.villager.item7.tip: Picks the horde size randomly between the min and max values.
zombietide.settings.villager.item8.desc: Lower bound for the random count
zombietide.settings.villager.item8.name: Min Count
zombietide.settings.villager.item8.tip: Only used when Random Count is on.
zombietide.settings.villager.item9.desc: Upper bound for the random count
zombietide.settings.villager.item9.name: Max Count
zombietide.settings.villager.item9.tip: Only used when Random Count is on.
zombietide.settings.warning.item1.desc: No messages, titles or sounds when off
zombietide.settings.warning.item1.name: Enable Warnings
zombietide.settings.warning.item1.tip: Disables morning warnings, trigger titles and all sounds.
zombietide.settings.warning.item2.desc: Show a title when a horde triggers
zombietide.settings.warning.item2.name: Title Warning
zombietide.settings.warning.item2.tip: Only active when Enable Warnings is on.
zombietide.settings.warning.item3.name: Horde Trigger Sound
zombietide.settings.warning.item3.tip: Plays on trigger; players near a villager horde hear it too
zombietide.settings.warning.item4.name: Morning Warning Sound
zombietide.settings.warning.item4.tip: Only the warned player hears it
zombietide.settings.warning.item5.name: Scatter Sound
zombietide.settings.warning.item5.tip: Only the player-horde target hears it
zombietide.settings.warning.item6.desc: Random background music during a horde
zombietide.settings.warning.item6.name: Horde Background Music
zombietide.settings.warning.item6.tip: Every 30s-2min during a horde; only the target hears it and it stops when the wave ends
zombietide.settings.warning.item7.desc: Broadcast radius of villager horde alerts
zombietide.settings.warning.item7.name: Villager Warning Range
zombietide.settings.warning.item7.tip: Players in range receive the title, sound and chat message.
zombietide.settings.world.item1.name: Daylight Burn
zombietide.settings.world.item1.tip: Off: all zombies (including natural spawns) no longer burn in daylight.
zombietide.settings.world.item2.desc: Players cannot sleep during a horde
zombietide.settings.world.item2.name: Block Sleeping
zombietide.settings.world.item2.tip: Blocks sleep during a player horde or a nearby villager horde.
zombietide.settings.world.item3.desc: Radius where a villager horde blocks sleep
zombietide.settings.world.item3.name: Villager Sleep Block Range
zombietide.settings.world.item3.tip: Players in this radius cannot sleep during a villager horde.
zombietide.settings.world.item4.name: Blood Debt Mode
zombietide.settings.world.item4.tip: Cumulative: adds survivors every wave. Last Only: keeps the latest wave. None: debt is always 0.
zombietide.settings.world.item5.name: Blood Debt Cap
zombietide.settings.world.item5.tip: Debt stops growing at the cap and is added to the next horde.
zombietide.settings.world.item6.name: Despawn Seconds
zombietide.settings.world.item6.tip: Scatter N seconds before sunrise; all removed at burn time
zombietide.settings.world.item7.name: Block Natural Zombie Spawns
zombietide.settings.world.item7.tip: Blocks natural Zombie/Husk/Drowned/Zombie Villager spawns. Horde spawning is unaffected.
zombietide.sleep.blocked: You had barely lain down when your eyes opened again.
zombietide.sleep.blocked.1: You had barely lain down when your eyes opened again.
zombietide.sleep.blocked.11: Closing your eyes now would be a mistake.
zombietide.sleep.blocked.12: You do not know what you are waiting for. You dare not sleep.
zombietide.sleep.blocked.2: The moment you closed your eyes, you were awake.
zombietide.sleep.blocked.4: You turned over, then turned back.
zombietide.sleep.blocked.6: You listened to your own heartbeat, louder and louder.
zombietide.sleep.blocked.7: Something is waiting for you to let your guard down.
zombietide.sleep.blocked.8: You tried counting sheep. You stopped halfway.
zombietide.sleep.blocked.9: It is too quiet to sleep.
zombietide.warning.subtitle: The horde is coming
zombietide.warning.title: Zombie Tide
zombietide.settings.spawn.item12.name: Spawn Screamers
zombietide.settings.spawn.item12.desc: 5% of horde zombies become screamers that call reinforcements
zombietide.settings.spawn.item12.tip: Disable to remove screamers entirely. World-level setting, applies to all players.
zombietide.settings.hud.item14.name: Gradient red DAY X
zombietide.settings.hud.item14.desc: DAY X gradually turns red, fully red when the omen window begins
zombietide.settings.hud.item14.tip: Gradient starts after the last horde ends. Disable to fall back to red on horde day / white otherwise.
zombietide.settings.atmo.item5.name: Horde Trigger Flash
zombietide.settings.atmo.item5.desc: Brief full-screen red flash on horde trigger
zombietide.settings.atmo.item6.name: Persistent Red Border
zombietide.settings.atmo.item6.desc: Red vignette during hordes, stronger with more nearby horde zombies
zombietide.settings.atmo.item6.tip: Visual only, fades away when zombies disperse.
zombietide.settings.spawn.item13.name: Screamer Cooldown Min (s)
zombietide.settings.spawn.item13.desc: Minimum cooldown between screams in seconds
zombietide.settings.spawn.item13.tip: Default 80s. Range 10-600. Actual cooldown is random between min and max. World-level setting.
zombietide.settings.spawn.item14.name: Screamer Cooldown Max (s)
zombietide.settings.spawn.item14.desc: Maximum cooldown between screams in seconds
zombietide.settings.spawn.item14.tip: Default 120s. Range 10-600, auto-clamped to min if smaller. World-level setting.
